entities.name: Inys Haen
entities.description: A settlement on Cridhe in the southwestern mountains, home of the Clan Tree and its Keepers.

entities.name: Haen
entities.description: The First Keeper without a tree, after whom the settlement was named.

entities.name: Nohrish
entities.description: Descendants of Nohr who raided Inys Haen.

entities.name: RoNal
entities.description: Soldier who led the Nohrish raid.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: Daughter of the Keeper and last Keeper, taken in the raid.

entities.name: Thix
entities.description: Reckless noble kinsman of the Felonarch who set fire to homes.

entities.name: Jedhian
entities.description: Aylith's cousin who swore to rescue her.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: Former Felonarch who reformed and helped Aylith restore the Clan Tree.

entities.name: Arn
entities.description: Freed slave who became the new Keeper.

entities.name: Clan Tree
entities.description: Tree restored by the Mending of the Clan Tree.

entities.name: Soulslayer
entities.description: Long-lost blade Jedhian found in the wreckage.

entities.name: Parting
entities.description: Event that broke the Blessing Stone.

events.summary: The Nohrish raided Inys Haen to capture the Keeper and Aylith; the Keeper and his wife died and Aylith was taken.
events.quote: The Keeper and his wife perished in the flames

events.summary: Jedhian buried Aylith's mother with a sword that was later revealed to be the Soulslayer.
events.quote: a blade later revealed to be the long-lost Soulslayer

events.summary: Aylith and Nazir recited the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree.
events.quote: Reciting the ancient Awakening Ritual, they channeled the magic of the land and restored balance to the world

events.summary: Arn became the new Keeper as the Clan Tree grew for 1000 years.
events.quote: With the freed slave Arn as its new Keeper

relations.quote: leaving behind her cousin, Jedhian , who swore to rescue her
the Keepers of Inys Haen tried to keep the peace but were harassed by raiders from Inys Nohr twice a year
The settlement was named for Haen
